Date prepared:  February 3, 2026  Meeting Date: February 10, 2026

Subject:  Environmental Programs Annual Accomplishments and Highlights

RECOMMENDED ACTION: Receive and file a presentation on the Environmental
Programs activities.

STRATEGIC PLAN IMPLEMENTATION: This item supports the City’s 2025 Strategic Plan
Goal 1: Support Community Rebuilding and Long-Term Recovery and Goal, Goal 2: Drive
Economic Recovery and Restore Lost Revenue, and Goal 3: Advance Infrastructure
Resilience. Projects supporting these goals include Dark Sky Ordinance implementation,
Clean Power Alliance, Coastal Vulnerability Assessment, Clean Water, Solid Waste
Management, and compliance with State and Regional requirements. Other
environmental programs are part of normal operations.

DISCUSSION: The Environmental Programs staff will provide a presentation that will detail
the City’s environmental program activities, including energy, water conservation, pollution
prevention, waste reduction, coastal, and events and outreach.

ATTACHMENTS: None.
